added_models.model: IgM CD20xCD3 (imvotamab/IGM-2323 and cyno surrogate) in cynomolgus monkeys, humanized NSG mice and human PBMC cytokine assays

engagement.confidence_note: Conference abstract (Blood supplement). Monkey dosing used IgM CD20xCD3; later work names the cyno-cross-reactive surrogate IGM-2324, so product_in_model false.
engagement.note: IgM CD20xCD3 completely depleted circulating and tissue B cells in monkeys and humanized mice; no human depletion data yet.
engagement.quote: Similarly, bispecific IgM completely depletes circulating B cells in cynomolgus monkeys at doses of 300 mg per kg.
engagement.judgement: Opened at the 2019 abstract, the year the NHL phase 1 (NCT04082936) registered.

engagement.magnitude_basis: depth of peripheral B-cell depletion, monkey (near-complete) vs RA/SLE patients (insufficient)
engagement.confidence_note: Sponsor press release only; NCT06087406 (RA) and NCT06041568 (SLE) terminated with no posted results; no NHL depletion data found for NCT04082936. Comparison made outside MZL.
engagement.note: Monkeys showed near-complete blood and tissue B-cell depletion; imvotamab's RA/SLE phase 1b depletion was insufficient and development stopped.
engagement.quote: Interim data from the Phase 1b studies of imvotamab in rheumatoid arthritis and systemic lupus erythematosus show that the depth and consistency of B cell depletion is insufficient to meet our high bar for success,
engagement.reason: Depletion fell short in dosed patients
engagement.judgement: Paired by me: Oyasu 2023 (cyno, near-complete peripheral depletion incl. low-CD20 cells) against the sponsor's RA/SLE readout. Engagement admits any dosed humans; flagged imported_from RA. Tier 5 because no higher-tier record exists.

safety.note: IgM bispecific gave far less cytokine release than IgG bispecifics in vitro and in monkeys; no patient data yet.
safety.quote: Significantly, IGM-2323 exhibits vastly reduced cytokine release in vitro and in vivo, with at least equivalent T cell dependent killing of CD20-expressing target cells
safety.judgement: Opened at the abstract; the prediction is a named harm (CRS) the monkey and PBMC assays can show, predicted low.

safety.magnitude_basis: CRS frequency/severity, predicted low vs observed low
safety.confidence_note: EHA 2022 abstract (HemaSphere supplement, PMC9429641), no DOI; preliminary phase 1 data, CRS rates not given in the abstract. NCT04082936 terminated without posted results.
safety.note: Phase 1 imvotamab in R/R NHL up to 1000 mg showed low CRS and no ICANS, as the IgM preclinical data predicted.
safety.quote: an excellent safety and tolerability profile up to 1000 mg with low cytokine release syndrome (CRS), no immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome (ICANS) and limited neutropenia
safety.reason: Low CRS in patients, as predicted
safety.judgement: Paired by me: the EHA abstract reports patient safety but does not set it beside the 2019 preclinical cytokine data. Trial is mixed NHL with MZL enrolled, so imported_from NHL.

added_models.model: In-vitro T-cell activation/TDCC/CDC assays fitted to a mechanistic synapse-binding model (imvotamab dose response)

dose.magnitude_basis: concentration window of peak activity vs plasma levels at 100 mg and 1000 mg
dose.confidence_note: EHA 2022 abstract (HemaSphere supplement, PMC9429641), no DOI. The model was built after phase 1 showed lower responses at 600 and 1000 mg, so a retrodiction. Its prospective test (randomized 100 vs 300 mg phase 2) was never reported: the NHL trial terminated.
dose.note: Bell-shaped in-vitro model placed peak activity at 100 mg plasma levels and loss at 1000 mg, reproducing phase 1's lower high-dose responses.
dose.quote: Interestingly, the concentration range of IGM-2323 resulting in peak activity corresponded to the peak and trough plasma levels in patients following 100 mg dose.
dose.judgement: Retrodiction: the abstract itself states phase 1 had already seen lower response rates at 600 and 1000 mg before the model was fitted, so retro, not same.

added_models.model: Semi-mechanistic PBPK/PD model of epcoritamab trimer formation and tumour response (Genmab)

dose.confidence_note: Opening year is a proxy: the model used dose-escalation data and set the RP2D before expansion began (2020); first public in Li 2022. FDA BLA 761324 review cites it (per checker), hence model_filed true.
dose.note: PBPK/PD model fitted to monkey and escalation data predicted trimer formation plateaus at 48-96 mg and chose 48 mg.
dose.quote: Model-predicted trimer formation plateaued at doses of 48 to 96 mg. Simulation results suggest that the 48-mg dose may achieve optimal response rates in DLBCL and FL.
dose.judgement: Its own track: an in-silico system distinct from the monkey track that the draft scores untested for dose. The stated regimen target is the 48 mg plateau.

dose.magnitude_basis: dose at which response plateaus: predicted 48-96 mg vs observed ~48 mg
dose.confidence_note: Abstract-level. Exposure-response in FL (EPCORE NHL-1, NHL-3) from the sponsor; no MZL exposure-response exists. NCT03625037 has no posted results on ClinicalTrials.gov.
dose.note: Patient exposure-response in FL showed response plateauing at 48 mg exposures with flat CRS risk, as the model stated.
dose.quote: Higher epcoritamab exposure was associated with higher efficacy (ORR, CR rate, progression-free survival, overall survival; p < 0.05) with potential response rate plateau at 48-mg exposures.
dose.judgement: Paired by me with Li 2022. The 48 mg regimen was reached in patients (target reached = same); whether it worked in MZL is the efficacy question, untouched here. FL chosen over LBCL because its abstract states the plateau.

considered_not_added: Ublituximab B-cell depletion in MS (ULTIMATE I/II, Fox 2021 phase 2): a further human engagement readout for the existing ublituximab-exvivo-adcc track, not a new model system; belongs as a correction to that track (checker also proposes a 2017 engagement same from Sawas 2017).
Ublituximab murine primary CNS/intraocular lymphoma models (Ben Abdelwahed 2013, IOVS): no patient comparison found; no ublituximab CNS lymphoma trial.

Epcoritamab ex-vivo killing of patient lymphoma/CLL cells (van der Horst 2021; Blood Adv 2023 CLL): not used to pick patients and no per-patient comparison with clinical response found; CLL is outside the tile.
Liao 2026 joint PK/PD/Deauville model (post-CR dosing simulations in LBCL): built on 165 patients' data, simulations only, no prospective comparison; LBCL, not MZL.
Epcoritamab population PK (2025, Clin Pharmacokinet): descriptive patient model, not a preclinical prediction.
QSP model of loncastuximab + T-cell bispecifics (2025, NPJ Syst Biol Appl): combination with a non-member ADC; no patient comparison for a member in MZL.
Imvotamab NHL efficacy (60% ORR at 100 mg, EHA 2022) for MZL: no MZL-specific data and no imvotamab preclinical MZL model; mixed-NHL responses not scored for MZL efficacy.
Rituximab/obinutuzumab/ofatumumab models: not members of this tile's class list.
